map.为系列 SKU 起统一前缀：在母品牌下批量衍生风格一致的子系列名。: Creating a shared prefix for a product series: derive consistent sub-series names under the parent brand.
map.品类填「茶饮」、调性填「国风」，生成「茶语集、青岚、一盏春」等；其中「青岚」二字: Enter the category "tea drinks" and the tone "Chinese style" to generate names such as "ChaYuJi, QingLan, YiZhanChun"; among them QingLan has coherent imagery and a domain like qinglan.com is easy to register, making it suitable for a premium line.
map.品牌名需要注册哪些？: Which trademark classes does a brand name need?
map.核心类目在第 35 类（销售/电商）与产品类（如 30 类食品、25 类服装）注: Register in Class 35 (sales/e-commerce) and the product classes (e.g. Class 30 for food, Class 25 for clothing); for overseas use, also check target-country trademarks and domains, and run a similarity search after generating.
map.中英文品牌名必须一致吗？: Must the Chinese and English brand names match?
map.不必须。很多品牌中文与英文是不同词（如「小米 / MI」），但需保证视觉与发音联: Not necessarily. Many brands use different Chinese and English words (e.g. Xiaomi / MI), but the visual and phonetic associations should stay consistent to avoid confusion.
map.按所选风格从词库 A 随机取首段，未勾选短名时再拼接词库 B 的随机后段；勾选首: Randomly take the first segment from word list A for the selected style; unless the short-name option is on, also append a random trailing segment from word list B; when capitalize-first is on, uppercase the first character and lowercase the rest, otherwise lowercase everything; output count = count; each item independently random, duplicates allowed

map.为新品牌起现代风格名: Naming a new brand in a modern style
map.风格选「现代」、勾选「首字母大写」，可生成 Nomi、Zami、Vesa、Lum: Choose the "Modern" style and tick "capitalize first letter" to generate candidates such as Nomi, Zami, Vesa and Lumsa. Check trademarks and domains before use; this page does not assess registrability.
